title: package enable: after a module package is disabled and enabled again, every module's navigationContributions entries appear twice in the console sidebar until the server restarts
body:
## Source

Measured by HotCRM on platform **18.3.0** during hotcrm#2315 phase 1a (PR hotcrm#2418). The implementer's report is [hotcrm#2315 comment 6663533795](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2315#issuecomment-6663533795), in its out-of-scope findings. The screenshot `09` is in the HotCRM project files under `issue-2315/phase1a/`.

## What happens

The HotCRM artifact carries five packages. Four of them are modules that put entries into the app's navigation groups through `navigationContributions`.

1. `PATCH /api/v1/packages/app.objectstack.hotcrm.o2c/disable` answers 200.
2. `PATCH /api/v1/packages/app.objectstack.hotcrm.o2c/enable` answers 200.
3. The console sidebar now lists the contributed entries of every module twice: Service Overview, Cases and Knowledge (service); Quotes, Products and Price Books (revenue); the three Order to Cash entries.
4. It stays that way until the server restarts. After a restart, each entry is listed once.

So one module's enable duplicates the entries of all modules, not just its own. That suggests re-enable re-folds the contributions into the app without first dropping the folded copy.

## Ask

Package enable (and disable) re-derives the app's navigation from the enabled packages' contributions, so each entry appears exactly once after any number of disable and enable cycles. A test pins two cycles.

## Consumer

HotCRM documents module disable as the per-tenant switch for Service, Revenue, Marketing and Order to Cash (Admin Manual, #2383). An administrator who turns a module off and back on sees a doubled menu.
